title: Factorial matching count identity
statement: For positive integers $r$ and natural numbers $k$, the $1/(2r)$-th power of $\bigl((2r-1)/r\bigr)^{rk}(rk)!$, divided by $\sqrt{k!}$, equals the matching improvement constant times $(\sqrt{2r-1})^k$.
